entities.name: Zinnia
entities.description: Birdfolk stork troubadour who crashed into Three Tree City; nicknamed the Sovereign of Life.

entities.name: Dragonhawk
entities.description: Creature whose arrival was calamitous; Zinnia distracted and outraced it.

entities.name: Plumecreed
entities.description: Birdfolk royalty and elite soldiers whom Zinnia might be from.

events.summary: Zinnia crashed into Three Tree City and has delighted its citizens with their lute since.
events.quote: They crashed into Three Tree City - literally - and have been delighting citizens with their lute ever since.

events.summary: Zinnia led a daring rescue of animalfolk from a border village, distracting Dragonhawk and outracing it.
